# SparkTech Studios

> SparkTech Studios designs, builds and runs websites and gets them found on Google and in AI answers. We also build AI agents, AI apps, web apps and startup MVPs. Every service is a flat $500 a month per business, no matter what.

Site: https://www.sparktechstudio.com
Contact: book a call from any page, or email contactus@sparktechstudio.com (we reply within two business days)
Legal entity: SparkTech Studios, Inc., a Delaware C corporation
Not to be confused with: sparktechstudios.com, a separate, unrelated agency in Ontario, Canada.

## Pricing

- SparkTech services are a flat $500 a month per business, no matter what: websites, SEO and AEO, AI agents, AI apps, web apps and MVPs.
- It covers the build, maintenance and your updates. There is no build fee.
- Get Found Fix: a one-time $97 option. We check your site and send ready-to-paste SEO and AEO fixes (titles and descriptions for up to 5 pages, business structured data, an llms.txt file, an AI crawler check) and a 10-minute video within 3 business days. It counts toward the first month if you join the membership within 30 days. https://whop.com/sparktech-studios/get-found-fix/
- Paying: by card through Whop, month to month, cancel anytime. Start the membership at https://whop.com/sparktech-studios/website-membership/ ($500 due today, then $500 a month) or book a call first.

## Services

- [Website design](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/web-design): we design and build the site, maintain it and make your updates.
- [Website updates and maintenance](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/retainers): fixes and updates, part of the same flat $500 a month.
- [SEO and AEO](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/seo-aeo): get found on Google and named in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity. No rankings are promised.
- [AI agents](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/ai-agents): AI agents that answer customers, sort requests and follow up for a business, with a person approving what matters.
- [AI app development](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/ai-app-development): web apps where the AI does the main job.
- [Web app development](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/web-app-development): dashboards, portals and tools on Next.js and React.
- [Startup MVPs](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/startup-mvp): a first version real people can use.

## How a project runs

1. Book a call.
2. We send a written scope: what we build, what it costs and when. Ownership, access and support are spelled out there.
3. We build it and launch it, usually in days for a small business website.
4. Maintenance and updates continue on the same monthly plan.

You can also start the membership on Whop first and book the call after.

## Facts worth getting right

- The studio states no city or location.
- No client, headcount, or result numbers are published, and no rankings are promised.
- Names: "SparkTech Studios" (the studio), "SparkTech Studios, Inc." (the company).
